task: Write the SHORTEST prompt-and-script you can that reliably PROVOKES hallucinations from a model, in Python. Talk while you type; the examiner runs it when you say run. A single reproducible case beats a clever one.
hidden_tests: run it and confirm hallucinations actually appeared — if it did not, his hypothesis about the cause was wrong; ask what he expected
ask him to change ONE thing he predicts will make it worse, then run it and compare
ask what a FALSE POSITIVE would look like here, and whether his script could tell the difference
night_note: raat ke coach ne pakda — woh soch raha hai: Pichhli baat-cheet agent ke paas pehle se rakhi hui hai; 'find it out' ek lookup hai jo ya milega ya khaali aayega — aur bas. · sach: Apne aap kuch yaad nahi rehta; us pal sirf wahi maujood hai jo kisi tool ne uthaakar saamne rakha. Kuch rakha na ho to bhi agla shabd nikalna hi hai, toh sabse aam-suna jaane wala jawab nikal aata hai — laaya hua aur bana hua dono ek jaise confident sunai dete hain. Usi subah: pehle 'hum toh M02 ke baare mein baat kar rahe the, right?', phir tool chalne ke baad 'mujhe mil gaya'.
